Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.saturationops

Class ElectrolytePhaseBoundaryResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.saturationops.ElectrolytePhaseBoundaryResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ElectrolytePhaseBoundaryResult extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable diagnostics for a bracketed electrolyte phase-boundary calculation.

The boundary is represented by the final bracket because a finite phase-fraction threshold is required to classify a phase as material. The thermodynamic system is left at the bracket endpoint where the requested phase is present.

      public ElectrolytePhaseBoundaryResult(ElectrolytePhaseBoundaryResult.Specification specification, PhaseType targetPhase, double lowerBound, double upperBound, boolean targetPresentAtLowerBound, double targetPresentValue, double targetPhaseFraction, int iterations, int flashEvaluations, String lowerTopology, String upperTopology, double maximumMaterialBalanceResidual, double maximumPhaseNormalizationResidual, double aqueousChargeMolality, double maximumIonMoleFractionOutsideAqueous, double maximumLogFugacityResidual)
      Creates an immutable phase-boundary result.
      Parameters:
      specification - scanned variable
      targetPhase - phase whose appearance or disappearance is bracketed
      lowerBound - final lower numeric bound
      upperBound - final upper numeric bound
      targetPresentAtLowerBound - whether the target is present at the lower bound
      targetPresentValue - bound value at which the system is left
      targetPhaseFraction - target phase fraction at the retained state
      iterations - bisection iterations
      flashEvaluations - complete TP flash evaluations
      lowerTopology - phase topology at the lower bound
      upperTopology - phase topology at the upper bound
      maximumMaterialBalanceResidual - maximum component mole-fraction balance residual
      maximumPhaseNormalizationResidual - maximum phase or beta normalization residual
      aqueousChargeMolality - signed aqueous charge residual in mol/kg water
      maximumIonMoleFractionOutsideAqueous - largest ionic mole fraction outside aqueous phases
      maximumLogFugacityResidual - largest neutral-component cross-phase ln-fugacity residual
